record.question: According to the Mizoram Excise & Narcotics Manual, 2005, which one of the following option is not mentioned amongst the duty of the Excise & Narcotics Constables place on duty in courts when Excise & Narcotics case are being tried?
options: To guard the prisoners in the Court premises.
To look after exhibits produced before the Court
To remove handcuffs when the accused is brought before a judge
To assist the Court Officer in any way that he may direct
